steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Configure a reverse price-based auction with lot awarding.
Choose the available reverse auction template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet, including the requested line-item fields where available.

args.goal: On the single-stage auction create screen, set the first line item's Plant Name or delivery location to LOC-0001, enable the basket auction option, and leave the basket auction interval time empty; stop with the basket-auction configuration visible and unchanged otherwise

steps.note: Configure the basket auction and deliberately omit its interval because no dedicated catalog step controls that setting.
